messages:
Rachel (People Ops): quick q on travel/expense rules — heading to a 2-day customer visit next week. Can I claim per diem for meals or do I need itemized receipts? also lost a taxi receipt yesterday, what's the right way to handle that? cc @Sarah (Finance)
Sarah (Finance): short answer — you can opt for per diem OR itemized receipts, not both. Domestic per diem is $60/day for meals (excl. alcohol). If you pick per diem, no meal receipts needed. If you submit actuals, attach receipts for anything >$25. For lost taxi receipts: submit the Lost Receipt Affidavit + manager approval in Concur, finance will process. :+1:
Miguel (Engineering): do we have to book through Concur/our travel portal or is self-booking allowed? and must I use the corporate card?
Sarah (Finance): preferred booking flow: Concur (company rates) or our approved travel partners. Corporate card is preferred for flights and hotels. If you use a personal card, you'll be reimbursed once you upload the receipt and manager approves. Rideshares (Uber/Lyft) — screenshot of the trip + card statement usually works.
Devon (Sales): client dinner question — are alcohol line items reimbursable? some dinners exceed the per-person cap.
Sarah (Finance): client meals that include alcohol are reimbursable but should be reasonable and itemized. Internal guideline: manager pre-approval required for alcohol or total meal > $75 per person. Provide attendee list + business purpose.
Rachel (People Ops): thanks. for the lost taxi receipt — is the Lost Receipt Affidavit a PDF I can sign electronically?
Sarah (Finance): yes — pdf in Concur > Forms > Lost Receipt Affidavit. Fill, sign, attach the best available backup (card statement, trip confirmation) and get your manager to add an approval note. If you want the steps:
```
1. Open Concur > Expenses > Create New Expense
2. Choose Expense Type: Ground Transportation
3. Attach any backup (screenshot of ride, card statement)
4. Upload Lost Receipt Affidavit (Concur > Forms)
5. Add manager in Approvals and submit
```
Sarah (Finance): once submitted, expensify-bot will post an automated confirmation. Finance aims to reimburse within one payroll cycle but expedite if tagged as urgent.
expensify-bot: Expense 171120-423 submitted by Rachel (People Ops) — status: Pending Manager Approval. View: https://concur.example.com/expenses/171120-423 :robot_face:
Miguel (Engineering): one more — per diem for partial travel days? if you leave after lunch on day 1, do you get full day?
Sarah (Finance): partial days: if travel includes an overnight stay, per diem applies to the travel days. For single-day trips (no overnight), no per diem — submit receipts. See policy page in Handbook > Travel & Expenses for edge cases.
Rachel (People Ops): perfect, i'll use per diem and attach the taxi affidavit for the missing receipt. thanks all :raised_hands:
